market_summary: European morning session displays tight consolidation across major pairs and crypto. EURUSD and GBPUSD are trapped inside their session Value Areas hovering near POCs without RVOL breakout confirmation. BTCUSD maintains a consistent downtrend below session VWAP and EMA50 but is currently consolidating directly into local horizontal support zones. High-probability edges are lacking across the board; holding cash is warranted until NY overlap liquidity arrives.

signals.rationale: 1) Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10773, VAH 1.10981) and trading right at POC 1.10946. 2) CVD is BULLISH (+3,833) with a positive slope (+1,009.55), confirming persistent buying pressure into London morning. 3) Market SESSION is LONDON_SESSION, presenting active liquidity. 4) Price remains firmly above VWAP (1.10849) and EMA50 (1.10881), maintaining an intraday bullish structural posture. 5) Candles are consolidating near the upper portion of the ATR channel under ATR Upper (1.10972). 6) RVOL is 0.727 with no recent yellow breakout spikes, signaling lack of high-volume expansion momentum. 7) Price is approaching Session High resistance at 1.10988. Because price is inside the Value Area right at POC and nearing Session High without RVOL expansion, upside continuation is capped; recommend HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bullish holding above rising VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: 1) Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.32593, VAH 1.32797) just below POC (1.32738). 2) CVD is BEARISH (-2,298) which diverges against the recent upward push toward EMA50. 3) Market SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Trend vs VWAP is neutral to slightly positive as close (1.32712) sits above VWAP (1.32662) but tightly hugging EMA50 (1.32694). 5) ATR band position is mid-channel between lower 1.32543 and upper 1.32796. 6) RVOL is low at 0.66 with no breakout volume confirmation. 7) S/R support at 1.32661 was defended, but overhead Session High (1.32809) provides immediate resistance. Conflicting CVD divergence and containment inside Value Area near POC favor HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral oscillating around VWAP and EMA50

signals.rationale: 1) Price is trading near VAL (73397.14), positioned below POC (73541.61) inside a tight lower distribution. 2) CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) with flat/negative slope, agreeing with the downward pressure. 3) Market SESSION is LONDON_SESSION. 4) Price is consistently tracking below VWAP (73619.42) and EMA50 (73631.01), both sloping downwards in a clear downtrend. 5) Candle action is hovering near the lower half of the ATR channel above ATR Lower (73123.59). 6) RVOL sits at 1.065 without yellow volume spikes, reflecting grinding sell-side pressure rather than climax exhaustion. 7) Retesting local S/R support-turned-resistance around 73386.8; however, with price compressing near local support shelves (73284.6 and Session Low 73166.0) without breakout impulse, setup favors HOLD.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish sustained below downward sloping VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection below VAL and EMA20 baseline
